description: This is a Grunt configuration file for the Summernote project, defining build tasks, testing, and deployment procedures.

methods.name: server
methods.description: Runs a development server with connect and watch tasks.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Runs lint and Karma tests in watch mode.

methods.name: test-travis
methods.description: Runs lint and Karma tests configured for Travis CI.

methods.name: saucelabs-test
methods.description: Runs Sauce Labs tests via Karma.

methods.name: dist
methods.description: Builds distribution files, including cleaning, building, testing, copying, minifying, and compressing.
